_note: Findings of tooling/check-proof-module-preflight.py that were in the tree when the check was introduced, one key each. They are reported as known and do not fail; any other finding fails. A key that no longer occurs is reported as stale (an error with --strict or --baseline-base, as CI runs it): delete it. A key added later fails against the base branch's baseline (--baseline-base) unless it occurs and `reasons` gives it a reason of at least 40 characters and six words.

reasons.UnitLifecycleDecryptScreen|no-negatives-: a satisfiability screen of the decrypt refinement's hypotheses; its controls are in check-session-satisfiability-negatives.sh, a shell script, which the preflight does not read
reasons.UnitLifecycleIntegrationScreen|no-negati: a satisfiability screen of the integration's hypotheses; its controls are in check-session-satisfiability-negatives.sh, a shell script, which the preflight does not read
reasons.UnitLifecyclePublicT1|no-negatives-scrip: UnitLifecyclePublicT1 only composes the already checked T1 layers for the five public entry points; it has no negatives script of its own, and its pins are held by check-attest-negatives.sh
reasons.UnitLifecycleT1|no-negatives-script: UnitLifecycleT1 holds the nine primitive-boundary contracts and the T1 lemmas the public composition uses; it predates the per-module negatives scripts, and its pins are held by the attestation negatives (check-attest-negatives.sh)
reasons.UnitLifecycleT1|no-section: UnitLifecycleT1 predates the per-module CLAIMS.md sections; its results are cited from other sections, and no Proved section's Location line names it
